subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the canonical broad tracker for Control UI zh-CN tab localization while the overlapping open PRs are sequenced, or should maintainers split it into narrower page-specific issues?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but multiple overlapping open PRs already cover partial slices and the issue carries no-new-fix-pr/product-decision signals, so automation should not create another broad translation PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and sequence PRs
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker, review or consolidate the page-specific open PRs, and avoid opening a new automated fix PR until maintainers choose the landing order.

options.title: Split into page-specific canonical issues
options.body: Close or relabel this as an umbrella after creating narrower page-specific localization issues for Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, Debug, and docs separately.

options.title: Defer full zh-CN UI completion
options.body: Leave current partial localization in place and only accept opportunistic focused improvements when maintainers have reviewer bandwidth.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and sequence PRs
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker, review or consolidate the page-specific open PRs, and avoid opening a new automated fix PR until maintainers choose the landing order.

likelyOwner.reason: The main unresolved choice is how to sequence generated Control UI i18n work, and Vincent Koc has the clearest history on the Control UI locale pipeline.
